notablePrerequisites: Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
